concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: Central concept of the torah. Hitbodedut is the only path to becoming a true ish kasher. No bechina language is used — all relationships are eitza (cause-effect).
Goal concept — impossible to achieve without hitbodedut. Relationship is eitza, not bechina.
Exemplar of hitbodedut practice. His breaking of the heart before God is identified as the essence of Sefer Tehillim.
Product of David's hitbodedut practice. Relationship to David is eitza, not bechina.

concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.concept_en: Descendants of the Baal Shem Tov
concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset.note: Mentioned as especially accustomed to hitbodedut because they descend from David HaMelech.
